mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months (measured as the 3-month change in FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of FEDFUNDS decline are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 7.0% (measured as the current UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market that boosts corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 7.0%, or the difference in mean returns between triggered and non-triggered periods is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand that supports corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive returns in more than 45% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression model has a coefficient that is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A supply-constrained economy (measured by INDPRO growth rate below 0.5% annually) signals weak industrial output that reduces corporate profit margins, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 55% of instances when INDPRO growth < 0.5%, or the difference in mean returns between triggered and non-triggered periods is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in the CPIAUCSL above 2.5% signals accelerating inflation that prompts monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or the difference in mean returns between triggered and non-triggered periods is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) signal strong residential construction activity that supports economic growth and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in periods of rising HOUST are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A tight labor market (measured by PAYEMS growth exceeding 0.5% monthly) signals strong wage growth that increases corporate costs and reduces profit margins, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 55% of instances when PAYEMS growth > 0.5%, or the difference in mean returns between triggered and non-triggered periods is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising industrial production (INDPRO) and contracting GDP (GDPC1) signals a supply-driven economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising INDPRO and contracting GDPC1 fails to produce negative returns in more than 45% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression model has a coefficient that is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
